about:
The Urban Wood Company was founded in 2021 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The business began as a supplier of premium kiln-dried live edge slabs, dimensional lumber, and reclaimed wood, and has since expanded into a full-service custom furniture and cabinetry shop.

The company operates what it describes as the largest vacuum kiln in the state alongside a fully equipped woodshop. Its sawmill capabilities include an on-site bandsaw mill with a 26-inch by 21-foot cutting capacity and an off-site mill capable of 58-inch by 18-foot cuts. Services span custom furniture design, milling, slab flattening, and wood drying, producing items such as live edge tables, river tables, conference tables, kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, storage systems, and architectural millwork.

The shop serves both residential and commercial clients, including homeowners, designers, and contractors seeking high-end custom pieces. Testimonials reference individual customers ordering floating shelves, dining tables, and slab selections for personal projects, while the commercial side addresses office conference tables and similar installations.

The company emphasizes its end-to-end control from slab to finish, highlighting the vacuum kiln for stable, dry lumber and the precision of its milling and woodshop operations. Customer feedback consistently points to knowledgeable staff and responsive service as distinguishing factors.
